Fluently é o app de idiomas que faz você falar. Lições curtas ensinam as frases, tutores de IA fazem você usá-las em voz alta, e tudo que você erra volta até fixar. Um curso completo em 9 idiomas, prática de conversação em 29.

UM CURSO QUE FAZ VOCÊ FALAR
• Lições rápidas de cerca de quatro minutos: ouça, fale, construa, combine.
• 8 seções das primeiras palavras a conversas reais (A1 a B2), com mais de 240 lições e 1.000 frases em cada curso.
• Você fala em todas as lições, e o que você diz é avaliado na hora.
• Um guia de gramática junto ao curso, com exemplos que você pode ouvir.
• Já sabe um pouco? Um teste de nivelamento permite pular etapas.
• Cursos em inglês, espanhol, francês, alemão, italiano, português, holandês, russo e turco.

CONVERSE COM TUTORES DE IA
• 385 cenários da vida real com objetivos a cumprir: pedir comida, entrevista de emprego, reunião de equipe, planejar um fim de semana com um amigo.
• 210 tópicos de conversação e 41 personas, de um professor paciente a um amante de comida ou gamer.
• Cada mensagem que você envia é avaliada como perfeita, boa ou precisa de revisão, com uma forma melhor de dizer.
• Travou? Traduza qualquer resposta, peça sugestões ou salve uma frase para depois.
• Escolha seu nível, de iniciante a avançado, e a conversa acompanha.

LIGUE PARA SEU TUTOR
• Fale com as mãos livres em uma chamada de voz. Seu tutor escuta, responde em voz alta e mantém a conversa.
• Ative legendas, mude o nível ou pause quando precisar.
• Desligue para ver um resumo: sua precisão, seu tempo e uma revisão de tudo que você disse.

ESTUDE O QUE VOCÊ ERROU
• Palavras fracas traz de volta as frases que você continua errando, em cerca de três minutos.
• Erros guarda cada correção para você tentar de novo.
• Falar e ouvir treina suas próprias frases.
• Match Madness: combine palavras com seus significados contra o relógio.
• Histórias curtas em três níveis, lidas em voz alta, com perguntas no final.

VEJA SEU PROGRESSO
• XP, uma sequência diária com congelamentos de sequência e conquistas para desbloquear.
• Cada palavra que você aprendeu em uma lista, marcada como aprendendo ou forte.
• Lembretes que mantêm sua sequência viva.

29 IDIOMAS PARA PRATICAR
Inglês, espanhol, francês, alemão, italiano, japonês, chinês, russo, coreano, português, árabe, holandês, sueco, norueguês, turco, polonês, grego, hebraico, dinamarquês, hindi, tcheco, ucraniano, vietnamita, húngaro, romeno, indonésio, finlandês, malaio e persa.

Inko turns "I should practice speaking" into something you actually do every day. Pick a scene, talk with a friendly AI for just 60 seconds, and the moment you finish, you get a personal lesson note: what you said, and how a native speaker would say it instead.

SPEAK FOR 60 SECONDS A DAY
• Swipe through immersive, short-video-style scenes and jump straight into a conversation
• Open-mic, real-time voice chat. Interrupt, hesitate, think out loud, just like a real call
• Stuck? Say it in your own language. Inko understands, rephrases it naturally, and keeps the conversation going

GET A LESSON MADE JUST FOR YOU
• After every chat, Inko writes a lesson note from YOUR conversation
• See "you said this → a native would say this" rewrites, side by side
• Replay your own voice and read the full transcript

TURN LESSONS INTO YOUR OWN STUDY MATERIAL
• Save words, phrases and idioms with one tap
• Review them as flashcards and mark the ones you have mastered
• Saved phrases come back in tomorrow's conversation, so you actually use them

REVIEW WITH YOUR PERSONAL PODCAST
• Turn your lesson notes into a two-host review podcast, generated just for you
• Listen with subtitles, in the background, on the go

LEARN 40+ LANGUAGES
• English, Spanish, Korean, Japanese, French, German, Chinese and many more
• Explanations in your native language, expressions in your target language

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• Lesson notes, phrases and recordings are stored on your device
• Delete your data, or your whole account, anytime

One minute a day is enough. Meet your coach, start talking, and watch your speaking improve.

INKO PRO (AUTO-RENEWABLE SUBSCRIPTION)
Inko Pro unlocks unlimited conversations, lesson notes, flashcards and review podcasts.
• Weekly: $5.99 / 1 week
• Monthly: $14.99 / 1 month
• Annual: $99.99 / 1 year
Prices are in USD and may vary by region; the exact price for your region is shown in the app before you buy.

• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
• The subscription renews automatically for the same price and period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Live Translator is designed for those who demand precision, not just word-for-word substitution. Unlike standard translation tools, we leverage state-of-the-art Multi-Model AI technology to act as your personal, experienced interpreter. We capture the nuance, tone, and cultural context of every sentence.


Whether you are deciphering a menu in a foreign country, negotiating in a business meeting, or chatting with new friends, Live Translator ensures you are understood instantly and accurately.



THE ULTIMATE TRANSLATION SUITE
We seamlessly integrate text, voice, camera, and keyboard translation into one intuitive interface. You focus on the conversation; we handle the complexity.
- Context-Aware Text Translation: Type or speak to translate. Choose your specific AI expert mode (e.g., Daily Chat, Business, Travel, Dining) to get results tailored to the situation.
- Real-Time Voice Interpreter: Speak naturally, and the app listens and translates instantly. Features Hands-Free and Headphone modes for fluid face-to-face conversations or discreet listening.
- Instant Camera Translator: Don’t let language barriers stop you. Snap a photo of menus, street signs, or documents. Our AI recognizes and translates text directly on the image.
- Live Translation Keyboard: Break language barriers inside any app. Chat on social media or send emails in your native language, and our keyboard automatically translates your text into the recipient's language before you hit send.



WHY AI MATTERS: ACCURACY & NUANCE
Traditional translators often fail at slang and idioms. Our advanced LLMs (Large Language Models) understand context.


SEE THE DIFFERENCE:
Traditional: "No cap" → "No limit" (Incorrect literal translation)
Live Translator: "No cap" → "For real / I'm not lying" (Accurate slang interpretation)
We optimize for grammar, meaning, and cultural relevance, ensuring your output sounds like a native speaker.

- Seamless Translation: Chat in WhatsApp, Messenger, or email clients without switching apps.

- Interview Prep: Practice answers to common questions in your target language.

record.name: Menzi: Learn Chinese
record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Recognizing a word is not the same as being able to use it. Cards advance through production: you compose the target word into your own sentence, and a language model evaluates that sentence for comprehension, accuracy, and complexity before the word moves forward in your review schedule.

Four axes of mastery

Real language is multimodal, so Menzi tracks every word across four axes: meaning, reading, listening, and speaking. A word counts as mastered only when you understand it, can read it, catch it in speech, and say it out loud. Extend that across thousands of words and fluency emerges.

Grammar, not just vocabulary

Words are the building blocks; patterns hold them together. Menzi includes a structured library of high-frequency grammar patterns with their own practice and progress tracking, so you’re building sentences instead of stacking nouns.

Your vocabulary is the material

Menzi doesn’t teach from a fixed corpus. Your deck is what everything is generated from: stories, listening sentences, grammar drills, and the tutor’s own conversation are all built from words you already hold, with a deliberate margin of new ones mixed in.

You set that margin. Pull a story toward the familiar and it reads almost entirely in words you know; push it the other way and it stretches you. This is comprehensible input in the technical sense, and it is hard to come by any other way — material at your exact level has to be made for one person.

Nothing you meet gets lost

Every sentence you write, story you read, and conversation you hold is scanned for words you haven’t formally studied. Each one is filed into a backlog with a count of how often you’ve met it, so the words you keep running into rise toward the front on their own.

They arrive at a pace you can absorb. New words enter your deck only as your schedule has room for them, measured against what is already due — so exposure can run ahead of study without your daily review turning into a wall. What you meet in the practice Menzi generates becomes the material the next round is generated from.

Immersive practice

• Talk with a live AI tutor that guides you toward correct production with feedback as you go
• Transcribe spoken sentences built from your exact vocabulary
• Read and listen to stories with audiobook-style read-along playback, the spoken word highlighted as it goes

Analytics that keep up with you

See every word you’ve met and how well you know it, plus learning rate over time, listening minutes, and more.

Menzi subscriptions

Two auto-renewing subscriptions, each with a one-week free trial for new subscribers. Without a subscription, the free tier keeps character review, listening and speaking practice, and the story library. Menzi Casual is $7.99 per month, including 8M AI credits and 10 minutes of audio each month. Menzi Pro is $19.99 per month, including 20M AI credits and 30 minutes of audio each month. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase, or when the free trial ends. The trial converts to a paid subscription unless cancelled at least 24 hours before it ends. It renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel it in your Apple ID account settings.
